title: Clarity changes your world. Shared clarity changes the Yuga.
personal: Once you clearly understand that we are the same Creator experiencing this game, the world completely changes for you. In Uday’s teaching, when this truth becomes clear to the world, the Yuga itself changes. When only a few understand, it is Kali Yuga. As more people understand, it becomes Dwapara Yuga, then Treta Yuga, and finally Satya Yuga when everyone or most people know the truth.
vision: Satya Yuga means the age of truth. Uday describes it as a wonderful world rich in culture, happiness, luxury, entertainment, and peace, without corruption. In this explanation, the Yugas express how widely the truth of our shared identity is understood and lived. The movement toward that world also unfolds within the game we entered.
